purpose: Close actual execution-location migration gap without treating legacy counters as migration

observed_current_behavior.legacy: dieroute_kernel selects smaller endpoint queue and increments counters;does not execute transferred search state
observed_current_behavior.speculative: Fixed windows,worker slot assignment,observer uses owners[task.source],all snapshot reads finish before ordered authority commit

required_invariants: Physical resource owner never changes because a task migrates
Task identity,epoch,priority,net,seed set and criticality preserved across transfer
Destination worker uses destination observer shadow view;all authority-dependent reads retained in validation journal
Migration alone does not grant capacity or publish paths
Fixed original commit order retained;stale proposals replay against authority;failed transfer has no authority side effects
Explicit source/destination queues,enqueue/dequeue/execution receipts bind every moved task to actual destination work
Count transferred task/seed bytes,queue work,replayed reads and unused migrated proposals;no zero-cost transfer assumption for cycle/performance claims
required_controls: Criticality/congestion aware migration with policy frozen before validation
required_validation: Actual RRBackend task execution in the migrated location,including stale remote shadow conflict and rejected capacity
Same-net sharing,unreachable transfer destination,queue saturation,duplicate/stale task receipt and deterministic ordering
Five-repeat complete native routing with independent task/queue/read-set/commit replay
Matched quality gates and representative scaling;CPU work/proxy bytes separate from hardware measured latency/bandwidth
Joint owner/search/publication implementation and physical performance remain required for full research
implementation_policy: Use isolated copied source;do not modify sources pinned by running jobs. Do not retune frozen present-schedule cohort or open heldout inputs. New migration policy evaluated independently after explicit source/config freeze.
